source: Snakes in hell, when did it get this bad? Can’t even grab a coffee from Asbury Gas without folks snickering or punks recording me behind my back. Like I’m some buffoon about to walk on a banana peel. Headlines tore me to shreds after my shooting accident, and that dumb internet video made me into a joke… a meme or whatever. No one expects me to fill my father’s shoes anymore. My pa, the great Aldous Snow... legendary lawman, hotshot gunslinger, bringin’ justice to the worst of ‘em. I look around… not a lick of respect for me or my Sheriff’s badge. Maybe that’s the world tellin’ me to turn it in…
target: 真是见鬼了，到底是什么时候变得这么糟的？连去阿斯伯里加油站买杯咖啡，都有人窃笑，或是几个小混蛋在背后偷拍我。仿佛我是个正要踩上香蕉皮的蠢蛋。那场走火意外之后，报纸把我骂得狗血淋头；网路上那支蠢影片又把我变成了笑话……什么迷因之类的玩意儿。现在已经没人指望我能接我父亲的班了。我老爸，了不起的阿尔道斯・史诺……传奇执法人员、神枪手，专门把那些最恶劣的家伙绳之以法。 放眼望去……没半个人尊重我，也没人把我这枚警长徽章放在眼里。也许这就是世道在告诉我，该把徽章交出去了……

source: I gotta get a handle on Romina. Maybe come down hard on these social workers that keep shruggin’ her off. Her schizophrenic meltdowns are raisin' hell, damaging property all of a sudden, and it feels like only a matter of time until she hurts someone… I jailed her for the night – maybe the third time in a month? She was smashin' beer bottles on the stop sign near the Praetis’ house. Yelling about beelzebub and demons and “a reckoning to the one-eyed angel.” Poor Everly Praetis... her voice shakin' on the phone. Romina's gonna sleep off the booze and start hollerin’ apocalypse at sunup. As usual, she's out at dawn and running off into Pine Hills Park, God knows where. The town is riding my hide about getting her off the streets... permanently. She's a Piney though – one of us Asbury people for decades now. What do we got if we don't take care of our own? But she's never been this bad...
target: 我得想办法处理萝蜜娜的事。也许该好好逼一逼那些老是把她推来推去的社工。她思觉失调发作时闹得天翻地覆，现在还开始破坏东西，感觉伤到人也只是迟早的事…… 我把她关了一夜——这个月大概第三次了吧？她在普雷蒂斯家附近，拿啤酒瓶砸停车标志。嘴里喊着别西卜、恶魔，还有什么「独眼天使的清算」。可怜的艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯……打电话来时，声音都在发抖。萝蜜娜睡一觉醒了酒，天一亮又会开始嚷嚷世界末日。照惯例，黎明就得放她走，然后她又跑进松丘公园，天知道躲到哪里。镇上的人都在逼我，要我让她从街上消失……永远消失。 可她也是松林镇民啊——在阿斯伯里住了几十年的自己人。要是连自己人都不照顾，我们还剩什么？但她以前从没这么严重过……

source: Sweet Lord Jesus on the cross, I’d like to offer today’s prayer to Romina. She came into the gas station drunk, again, and loafed around while arguing with them voices in her head. Smelled like somethin' awful in her ratty coat. It took all my strength to remain polite and firm even though she was cussin’ and throwin’ an imaginary fit in front of customers. Shameful! I gave her a free cup of coffee to get her to leave. But boy, how I wanted to slap some sense into her, tell her to git like a mangy cat. I had these terrible thoughts of, ya know, wantin' her to, I suppose, join you in heaven… peacefully of course. She's in pain. Everyone knows she chose drugs over salvation and that’s why she’s lost. But I realize I gotta pray and hope and remember the story from the Book of Mark where Jesus touches and heals the lepers. Though… even the lepers had the respect to live away from the normal townsfolk. Romina doesn’t seem to care about anyone but herself. Plain selfish. Why won’t she pull herself out of the bottle? Why put problems on other people? We all got our own! Doesn’t she have even a pea-size sense of decency? Lord help me, she really does boil my goose!
target: 十字架上慈爱的主耶稣啊： 我今天想为萝蜜娜祷告。她又醉醺醺地走进加油站，在里头晃来晃去，跟脑子里那些声音吵架。她穿着那件破外套，身上的气味难闻得很。她在客人面前满嘴脏话，对着不存在的东西大发脾气，我可是使尽了力气，才忍住没失礼，坚持请她离开。真丢人！我送了她一杯咖啡，才把她打发走。 可是啊，我多想一巴掌把她打醒，像赶癞皮猫那样叫她滚。我竟然起了这种可怕的念头：就是……希望她干脆去天堂陪您算了……当然，是平平安安地去。她这么痛苦。大家都知道，她选了毒品，没选救赎，才会迷失成这样。不过我明白，我得祷告、得抱着希望，得记住《马可福音》里，耶稣伸手触摸并医好痲疯病人的故事。 可是……就连痲疯病人都懂得体谅别人，住得离正常镇民远远的。萝蜜娜好像除了自己，谁也不在乎。自私透顶。她为什么不能自己走出酒瓶？为什么要把麻烦丢给别人？我们每个人都有自己的麻烦！她连一丁点做人的分寸都没有吗？主啊，求您帮帮我，她真的快把我气炸了！

source: Mayor's Office: Hello, this is an automated message from the Asbury Pines Office of the Mayor. We are closed, but your call is important to Mayor Van Eisen. Please leave your name, phone number, and the reason for your call. We will contact you at our earliest convenience. Thank you.
target: 镇长办公室：您好，这是阿斯伯里松林镇长办公室的自动语音留言。目前已过办公时间，但范艾森镇长非常重视您的来电。请留下姓名、电话号码及来电事由，我们将尽速与您联络。谢谢。

source: Wilma Truitt: Howdy Mayor, it’s Wilma. Just wanted to say that it was nice chattin' at the gas station this morning and I think you’ve cooked up some really great plans to make our town safer. I think you're right... the days of Aldous Snow are long gone, bless his soul, and maybe Buzz’s best effort just isn’t enough. Anyway, I just wanted to mention that I’ve talked it over with the ladies in my book club and you’ve got our full backing with your community safety plans and growing our fine police force. So we'll nag our husbands 'till they agree, haha! Well, we’re sending y’all a couple blackberry cobblers. Thanks as always, God bless.
target: 威尔玛・特鲁伊特：镇长您好啊，我是威尔玛。就是想说，今天早上在加油站跟您聊得很愉快，而且我觉得您想出的那些计划真的很棒，一定能让我们镇上更安全。我想您说得没错……阿尔道斯・史诺的时代早就过去了，愿他安息，而巴兹即使尽了全力，或许还是不够。总之，我想跟您说，我和读书会的姊妹们都谈过了，您那些社区安全计划，还有扩编咱们优秀警队的主张，我们全力支持。我们会一直念老公们，念到他们点头为止，哈哈！对了，我们会送几份黑莓酥饼过去给各位。一直以来辛苦了，愿上帝保佑您。

source: Home sweet tent, or tent sweet home? Mmmm, look at this medicine for tonight. Chips for dinner and whiskey to shut up the loudness. The dark, the bits, the dark, the bits, the little girl, the rip... Half only, uggh. Bag half full of chips. Lookin’ on the bright side ha! A bag-half-full kinda night. The green gem necklace, and the one-eyed angel… I'll get her to the grave. The one-eyed angel. No one looks in my boot for secrets, haha – still got my knife. It’s all I got to control things. Shhhh let me think in there for once up there. Yes, yes, the pendant necklace with the green crystal angel inside. Mine -- my key from Pathfinder. She wears it every day. The rip, the green gem necklace, and the one-eyed angel… Hmmph, chips are a little wet. Everything gets soaked out here in the deep dark of Pine Hills Park. Where no one goes. At least I’m free where no one goes. I need to tell Everly how important she is, the most important. She has to go to the other side! The bits, the little girl, the rip.. Hoo boy, okay, okay, come here whiskey, it’s medicine time.
target: 甜蜜的帐篷之家，还是甜蜜的家之帐篷？嗯嗯，瞧瞧今晚的药。薯片当晚餐，威士忌让那些吵闹闭嘴。 黑暗，碎片，黑暗，碎片，小女孩，裂缝…… 只有半袋，唉。半袋满满的薯片。往好处想嘛，哈！今晚就是个半袋满的夜晚。 绿宝石项链，还有独眼天使…… 我要把她带到墓地去。那个独眼天使。没人会翻我的靴子找秘密，哈哈——我的刀还在。只有它能让我掌控事情。嘘，上头里头的那些家伙，让我安安静静想一次行不行。对，对，那条坠子里有绿色水晶天使的项链。我的——寻路者给我的钥匙。她每天都戴着。 裂缝，绿宝石项链，还有独眼天使…… 哼，薯片有点湿。松丘公园又深又暗的这地方，什么都会湿透。没人来的地方。至少在没人来的地方，我是自由的。我得告诉艾芙莉，她有多重要，她是最重要的。她一定得去另一边！ 碎片，小女孩，裂缝…… 哎呀，好啦好啦，威士忌过来，吃药时间到了。
萝蜜娜：不要，阿尔道斯！发发慈悲吧！

source: Buzz: It’s Buzz, Romina. My pa Aldous is with the angels. Hold still – do you understand why I’ve gotta cuff you and take you in again?
target: 巴兹：我是巴兹，萝蜜娜。我老爸阿尔道斯已经跟天使在一起了。别动——妳知不知道，我为什么又得把妳铐起来带回去？

source: Romina: PLEASE! I hate the station! I’m just trying to get on my way. The dark, the bits, the little girl, the rip...
target: 萝蜜娜：求求你！我讨厌警局！我只是想走我的路。黑暗，碎片，小女孩，裂缝……

source: Buzz: Romina, you were scarin' folks this time! What on earth were you thinking? Throwin’ pennies at folks walking into the grocery store? That’s harm, you understand? Causing harm to others.
target: 巴兹：萝蜜娜，妳这次把大家吓坏了！妳到底在想什么？拿一分钱硬币丢要进杂货店的人？这是在伤人，懂不懂？妳在伤害别人。

source: Romina: They don’t care for my feelings! I see those people seeing me with HATE. I just need some medicine, and then everyone acts like I’m the only one that needs some medicine. We all need fucking medicine!
target: 萝蜜娜：他们才不管我的感受！我看得见，他们看我的眼神里只有恨。我只是需要一点药，结果每个人都搞得好像只有我需要吃药。我们他妈的全都需要药！

source: I just had a perfect day. Kids splashing in the pool, Danny grilling our fave bratwursts, then naps all around. Dinner was pizza and brownies, and then we played Uno and caught lightning bugs in the yard… this is the stuff I should be living for and I feel just… detached? Like my skin pores close up and keep happiness from getting into my body.
target: 我刚过了完美的一天。孩子们在游泳池里玩水，丹尼烤了我们最爱的德式香肠，然后大家一起睡午觉。晚餐吃披萨和布朗尼，接着玩 UNO，在院子里抓萤火虫……这些应该就是我活着的意义，可我却只觉得……像个局外人？仿佛我的毛孔全都闭起来，不让幸福进到身体里。

source: I’m worried Danny’s getting sick of this shit. My shit. He’s given up like everything to take care of me… I just want to feel *not depressed* for once in my gd life
target: 我怕丹尼已经受够这些烂事了。我的烂事。为了照顾我，他几乎什么都放弃了……我只是希望这他妈的人生，能有一次觉得自己「不那么忧郁」。

source: The usual crap… I matter, I have to focus on good things, take my meds. It’s not like I haven’t been trying here
target: 还是那些老话……我很重要，要专心想好的事情，要按时吃药。又不是我没在努力。
到底是怎样啦啊啊

source: How are the bad thoughts... do you need me to drive down?
target: 那些不好的念头还在吗……要我开车过去吗？
妳当然很重要！！
妳的精神科医师怎么说？
妈
唉唷，妈。
不知道，也许吧

source: Did you tell your husband how you feel?
target: 妳有跟妳老公说自己的感受吗？

source: Oh, fancy that – the imbecile Danny Praetis is here… how can a guy be so smug while buying groceries? Look at him, sauntering to his Toyota – an Asian-made car, of course. What a patriot! I can only imagine how satisfying it would feel to walk right up and punch him in his know-it-all schoolboy glasses. I bet he’s a whiner, ha. Fucking idiot, galivanting around like HE’S the mayor of town. But he dropped out of the race – obviously he couldn’t take the heat! He doesn’t deserve Everly. If I ever get the chance to make his life hell…
target: 哎呀，真巧——丹尼・普雷蒂斯那个白痴也在这儿……一个人怎么连买个菜都能这么自以为是？看看他，晃呀晃地走向他的丰田——果不其然，亚洲制的车。真是爱国人士啊！要是能直接走过去，朝他那副自以为什么都懂的书呆子眼镜揍上一拳，不知道有多痛快。我敢打赌，他一定会哭哭啼啼，哈。混帐白痴，到处招摇，好像他才是镇长。可他自己退出竞选了——显然就是扛不住压力！他配不上艾芙莉。要是有机会让他生不如死……

source: The dark, the bits, the little girl… No listening from no one. Ears closed shut, shut up, shut up so tight my words don’t go in. I don’t want to threaten the one-eyed angel. She is so afraid that she fights and runs! I’m scared too, but I also understand it. She doesn’t yet. Oh yes, yes my third eye was opened wide by Pathfinder and I know this is more than him and me and pain and fear. The one-eyed angel must reach the gate in the wood and be gone. Gone. Make her gone. Like I once saw... The rip, the green gem necklace, and the one-eyed angel… Oh no, how terrible. Oh that is terrible. Let me… decide. Then, okay, I’ll decide how to use the knife and make her go. Run? Will she run? She won’t open her ears so I have to do it with some danger, some threat. Oh, such a mess now. But my path. My path is mine and it’s all I got and all I want. Is the knife right? The right fear? Will it make her go through the gate and be gone? Maybe need a bigger thing for fear. A weapon of bigger fear. Fear is the true weapon. Oh how, how, how! How terrible this is… The dark, the bits, the little girl, the rip, the green gem necklace, and the one-eyed angel… the dark, the bits, the little girl, the rip…
target: 黑暗，碎片，小女孩…… 没人听，谁都不听。耳朵全关上了，闭上，闭上，闭得那么紧，我的话进不去。 我不想威胁独眼天使。她怕得又打又逃！我也怕，可是我明白。她还不明白。对啊，对，寻路者把我的第三只眼睛彻底打开了，我知道这件事不只是他和我，不只是痛苦和恐惧。独眼天使一定得走到林子里那道门，然后消失。消失。让她消失。 就像我曾经看过的那样…… 裂缝，绿宝石项链，还有独眼天使…… 不，太可怕了。哦，这真是太可怕了。让我……决定吧。好，那我就决定该怎么用这把刀，让她走。跑？她会跑吗？她不肯打开耳朵，所以我只能弄出一点危险、一点威胁。哦，现在乱成一团了。可是我的路。我的路是我的，那是我仅有的一切，也是我唯一想要的。用刀对吗？这种恐惧对吗？能让她穿过那道门，然后消失吗？也许需要更大的东西来吓她。能制造更大恐惧的武器。恐惧才是真正的武器。 哦，怎么办，怎么办，怎么办！这一切真是太可怕了…… 黑暗，碎片，小女孩，裂缝，绿宝石项链，还有独眼天使……黑暗，碎片，小女孩，裂缝……
